name: SPCX AI Visibility Auditor
author: spcxai

sections.description:
Stop guessing. Turn your website into a self-funding asset.

The SpecX AI Visibility Auditor is a high-performance diagnostic tool engineered specifically for the 20-million WordPress SMB market. This plugin exposes the “Invisible Waste” hidden in your technical architecture, maps keyword rankings in positions 11-20, and calculates the exact financial Cost of Inaction (COI) affecting your business today.

By running a localized, ultra-lightweight structural scan, the SpecX Auditor detects crucial performance decay, checks header metadata for compatibility with modern AI search engine crawlers, and streams dynamic calculations detailing how much monthly revenue is leaking from your site.

External Services

This plugin relies on an external service to calculate search visibility and performance metrics. By running the diagnostic, the plugin sends a telemetry payload to:
* Telemetry Endpoint: https://calculateauditmetrics-qjv6klecxq-uc.a.run.app
* Telemetry Data Points Sent:
– domain
– plugins list
– page count
– WordPress version
– server speed
* Compliance URLs:
– Privacy Policy: https://spcx.ai/privacy.html
– Terms of Service: https://spcx.ai/terms.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ‘SpecX Auditor’ page in your WordPress Admin dashboard.
  4. Click ‘Initialize System Audit’ to execute the scan.
sections.faq:
How does it calculate the Cost of Inaction?

The plugin combines keyword metrics, organic traffic baselines, and conversion leak multipliers to assess the value of traffic lost to search decay.

Does this scan slow down my site?

No. The scan is designed to be lightweight, utilizing localized transient caching to store audit results for 24 hours, preventing performance overhead.

What are modern crawler compliance checks?

The plugin checks for standard semantic markup, schema configurations, and JSON-LD structural graphs to ensure your site’s data is digestible by LLM search crawlers.
